{{Top|leg}}
'''Moraj''' was a heroic [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who was a local hero to the first settlers of the Bestine Township.

==Biography==
The first settlers and founders of the [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]] Township erected a [[Moraj Memorial|memorial]] with the writing of—"in memory of brave Captain Moraj".

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Moraj was actually [[Nathan Larkins|Nathan "Moraj_Markinnison" Larkins]], a member of The Crescent Order, and one of the first beta testers of the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], who had died in a tragic car accident. In the game, a memorial was placed in his memory, providing a brief description of Captain Moraj.

During the launch of ''Star Wars Galaxies,'' players would receive [[Maroj Melon|Maroj melons]], a type of food to help players get started. This melon was yet another tribute to Nathan Larkins. However, the the name Maroj is a slight variation of Moraj.
